verdict: EQT's revenue fell 10% to $1.77 billion and attributable net income dropped to $279 million, as it deliberately curtailed gas production and prices slipped.

segments.name: Natural gas, NGL & oil sales
segments.note: Selling the gas, liquids and oil EQT produces in the Appalachian Basin.

segments.name: Gain on derivatives
segments.note: Gains on hedging contracts that lock in prices for future gas sales.

segments.name: Pipeline & other
segments.note: Moving gas through pipelines and other midstream income.

opex.name: Depreciation, depletion & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of wells and equipment over the gas they produce — a non-cash charge.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: People and the back office, including higher incentive pay this quarter.

opex.name: Other operating costs, net
opex.note: Other operating expenses and lease impairments, minus a small gain on asset sales.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $72M, partly offset by $44M of income from investments (mainly equity earnings from midstream stakes) and $1M of other income — a net $27M cost.

takeaways.title: Volumes down on purpose
takeaways.text: Sales volume fell 8% to 583 Bcfe, including 21 Bcfe of strategic curtailments — EQT held back gas rather than sell it at weak prices.

takeaways.title: Unit costs at the low end
takeaways.text: Total operating costs were $1.09 per Mcfe, at the low end of guidance, and free cash flow attributable to EQT was $283 million; net debt fell to $5.47 billion.

takeaways.title: Operating income fell
takeaways.text: Operating income dropped to $459 million from $603 million as lower sales and smaller derivative gains ($100M vs $136M) outweighed cost control.

oneTimers: Derivative gains added $100M to revenue this quarter (vs $136M a year ago) — these hedging marks swing with gas prices and are not the same as selling more gas.
footerNote: Figures are from EQT's Form 10-Q statements, reported in $ thousands and rounded here to the nearest $M. Net income of $345M is the consolidated total; $279M was attributable to EQT shareholders after $66M for noncontrolling interests. Direct costs group transportation & processing, production, purchased commodities and operating & maintenance, as presented in the 10-Q.
